description: This file defines an abstract class ShadowCheckpointService for managing git-based checkpoints in a workspace, including initialization, saving, restoring, and diffing checkpoints, with integration of external services like telemetry and VSCode warnings.

classes.name: ShadowCheckpointService
classes.description: An abstract class providing functionality for managing git-based checkpoints within a workspace, including initialization, checkpoint creation, restoration, diffing, and branch management, with event emission and error handling.

methods.name: reportError
methods.description: Captures and reports an error event via TelemetryService.

methods.name: showWarning
methods.description: Displays a warning message in VSCode, limited to 5 unique warnings.

methods.name: createSanitizedGit
methods.description: Creates a simple-git instance with environment variables sanitized to prevent interference.

methods.name: initShadowGit
methods.description: Initializes a shadow git repository in the checkpoints directory, with configuration and initial commit.

methods.name: writeExcludeFile
methods.description: Writes exclude patterns to the git info/exclude file.

methods.name: stageAll
methods.description: Stages all files in the git repository, with error handling.

methods.name: getNestedGitRepository
methods.description: Detects nested git repositories within the workspace.

methods.name: getShadowGitConfigWorktree
methods.description: Retrieves the core.worktree configuration of the shadow git.

methods.name: saveCheckpoint
methods.description: Creates a new checkpoint by committing current changes, emitting events, and returning the result.

methods.name: restoreCheckpoint
methods.description: Restores the workspace to a specific checkpoint commit, cleaning and resetting git state.

methods.name: getDiff
methods.description: Generates a diff of changes between two commits, including file contents before and after.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Emits an event with specified data, inherited from EventEmitter.

methods.name: on
methods.description: Registers an event listener, inherited from EventEmitter.

methods.name: off
methods.description: Removes an event listener, inherited from EventEmitter.

methods.name: once
methods.description: Registers a one-time event listener, inherited from EventEmitter.

methods.name: hashWorkspaceDir
methods.description: Creates a SHA-256 hash of the workspace directory path for identification.

methods.name: taskRepoDir
methods.description: Generates the directory path for a task's checkpoints repository.

methods.name: workspaceRepoDir
methods.description: Generates the directory path for workspace checkpoints based on hashed workspace directory.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task's branch in the checkpoints repository.

methods.name: deleteBranch
methods.description: Deletes a specified branch in a git repository, handling current branch and cleanup.
